name: Mazra Flintmane
source_profile:
Herdspeaker Mazra Flintmane (NG)

Mazra is an aging orcish matriarch elected by the heads of the principal Varkesh clans to represent their collective interests. She is respected for her wisdom, generosity, and ability to negotiate peace between frequently quarrelsome families.

Mazra views Cadorian settlement with considerable apprehension, but believes coexistence is possible. She has begun negotiating with representatives of Marquis Garrus Ashford over seasonal grazing rights and access to river crossings.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 49 (source excerpt; may be partial)
